Nalin  Fernando  Foundation
(Incorporation)
to organize lectures, seminars and educational trips
for the students enabling to prepare for government
exams;
to organize for involving in the volunteer activities
for area people in order to find ways to cover their
expenses of infrastructure requirements on housing,
water and road etc.;
to  find  our  practical  activities  to  protect  the
environmental  system  endangered  due  to  human
activities, to educate the society in order to minimize
the  damage  to  the  environment  and  to  create  and
friendly  environmental  society;
to implement leadership training programs for giving
due place for women, to identify the obstacles to the
livelihood and to find out due solution to overcome
from such obstacles;
to organize lecture serious and special medical clinics
for  pregnant  women,  to  conduct  programs  such  as
“Suwanari” and by identifying the diseases early to
get  necessary  consultations  for  avoidable  such
deceases;
to uplift the health, education and nutrition status of
infants and special attention needy children;
to  act  to  enhance  the  quality  and  infrastructure
facilities of pre-schools conducted in the rural levels
and  making  arrangement  to  improve  the  nutrition
level and good qualities of the students; and
to unite all the ethnic groups in order to improve the
national unity and cohesiveness in Sri Lanka.
